hero.title: A system for collecting, curating, and presenting digital art.

intro.paragraph1: D.A.M.N. (Digital Artwork Management Network) is a platform designed to simplify the organisation and presentation of digital artworks. It brings artwork data, collections, exhibitions, and display management together in one central environment, creating a structured workflow from archive to presentation.
intro.paragraph2: Whether used by artists, galleries, museums, or cultural institutions, D.A.M.N. supports the entire curatorial process. Artworks can be documented, enriched with metadata, organised into collections, and prepared for exhibitions without relying on scattered files or disconnected systems.
intro.paragraph3: By connecting collections with exhibitions and digital screens, D.A.M.N. creates a seamless link between administration and presentation. The platform is designed to make digital art easier to curate, maintain, and share while providing a flexible foundation for future projects and collaborations.

items.title: Archive
items.description: Store, organise, and manage digital artworks with structured information, metadata, and documentation.

items.title: Curate
items.description: Create collections, plan exhibitions, and establish meaningful relationships between artworks and their contexts.

items.title: Publish
items.description: Connect curated content to digital screens and make artworks accessible in different exhibition environments.
